mn24:2.5: ‘Personally having few wishes, he speaks to the mendicants on having few wishes. Personally having contentment … he’s an adviser and counselor, one who educates, encourages, fires up, and inspires his spiritual companions.’”
mn24:10.2: ‘Well, is the spiritual life lived under the Buddha for the sake of purification of mind?’ When asked this, you answered, ‘Certainly not.’
mn24:10.3: ‘Is the spiritual life lived under the Buddha for the sake of purification of view …
mn24:10.5: purification of knowledge and vision of what is the path and what is not the path …
mn24:10.6: purification of knowledge and vision of the practice …
mn24:10.7: is the spiritual life lived under the Buddha for the sake of purification of knowledge and vision?’ When asked this, you answered, ‘Certainly not.’
mn24:12.2: ‘Well, is purification of mind complete extinguishment with no fuel for grasping?’ When asked this, you answered, ‘Certainly not.’
mn24:12.3: ‘Is purification of view complete extinguishment with no fuel for grasping?’ …
mn24:12.5: purification of knowledge and vision of what is the path and what is not the path …
mn24:12.6: purification of knowledge and vision of the practice …
mn24:12.7: ‘Is purification of knowledge and vision complete extinguishment with no fuel for grasping?’ When asked this, you answered, ‘Certainly not.’
mn24:12.8: ‘Then is complete extinguishment with no fuel for grasping something apart from these things?’ When asked this, you answered, ‘Certainly not.’
mn24:17.14: Chariots at the Ready is finished—the fourth.
